description: Cells that are expected to move between saved and recalculated runs (EQ3 stability).
notes: Two categories found on this tree: stale cached values (the generator writes a seed cell but never refreshes the cached formula results that depend on it, so only recalculation updates them) and unstable conversions (a stable formula whose value the xls roundtrip re-serialises differently). No volatile-formula (TODAY/NOW/RAND) cell is read by any product's standardReads() or additionalReads today.
